title: design-checker bulgu raporu
$comment: The source skill (pcb-tool-v2 .claude/skills/design-checker) used a private PASS / CONDITIONAL PASS / FAIL vocabulary. This bundle has a CLOSED verdict vocabulary in skills/_shared/coverage-gate.md, so the private one is mapped onto it here instead of running in parallel: PASS->GREEN, CONDITIONAL PASS->CONFIRM, FAIL->RED, plus NO_COVERAGE and STALE which the source had no way to express and therefore silently reported as PASS.

verdict.$comment: Closed vocabulary. A checker that cannot express NO_COVERAGE will report an unexamined board as clean.

board_sha256.$comment: The board AS AUDITED. If it differs from the hash the Maker's report was taken against, the verdict is STALE - the audit describes a board that no longer exists.

independence.$comment: Maker/Checker is a ROLE split. If the same session produced and audited the design, shared-assumption error is unmeasurable and must be stated, not implied away.

rerun.$comment: false means the Maker's stored report was reused. Reading a report is not auditing; such a check cannot count toward scanned.

argv.$comment: Exact argv, so a reader can see whether --exit-code-violations and --severity-all were present. Without them kicad-cli exits 0 on a dirty board.

coverage.$comment: scanned + excluded == eligible, and scanned == 0 is NO_COVERAGE, never GREEN. Same arithmetic as tools/schemas/metric_coverage.schema.json.

severity.$comment: Severity, not count, decides the verdict: one CRITICAL outranks thirty LOW.

why_it_matters.$comment: A finding with no stated consequence cannot be triaged and tends to be dismissed.

evidence.$comment: Path to the measured artifact. A finding asserted without a measurement is a claim, not a finding.

maker_reported.$comment: true = the Maker also saw it; false = a blind spot. The blind-spot count is the actual yield of this skill.

fault_injection.$comment: Proof that the audit is not empty. Inject a known defect and the verdict must turn RED; if it does not, fix the audit, not the board.
